en.name: Diluc
en.ability: If you once nominate an evil & die the following night, an alive Archon learns this & a Minion dies tomorrow night.

revisions.v1: If you once nominate an evil & die the following night, an alive Archon learns this & a Minion dies tomorrow night.

en.flavor: Before the "dawn" comes, someone must light up the "darkness" a little...
en.otherNightReminder: If Diluc dies at the night and he nominate a evil player once, ST choose an alive [Archon], he learn this, and places a "Learn" token next to his character token. Then, the next night after Diluc dies, the ST chooses an evil player and places a "Dead" token next to his character token.
